newsitem.title: INDIA: India to invite bids for coal-bed gas exploration.
newsitem.headline: India to invite bids for coal-bed gas exploration.

text.p: The Indian cabinet on Saturday approved a policy to offer blocks for exploration of coal-bed methane through open competitive bidding, a government statement said.

The coal blocks will be awarded by a cabinet committee on the recommendation of an empowered panel of high ranking civil servants headed by the most senior civil servant in the Petroleum Ministry, the statement said.

Coal Minister Kanti Singh told Reuters that the Petroleum Ministry, in consultation with the Coal Ministry, would identify the blocks to be put on offer. Companies will be given five months for submitting their proposal, she said.
A royalty of 10 per cent would be charged from companies which would be allotted the blocks for exploration, she added.
